newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds stay subdued after USDA crop figure.
newsitem.headline: European feeds stay subdued after USDA crop figure.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market remained quietly this afternoon after higher than expected USDA U.S. soybean and corn crop figures kept most buyers sidelined. Only a few trades were reported.
"Buyers in Europe anticipated Chicago futures to drop sharply on the higher than expected USDA crop figures, so all in all we saw little trade this afternoon," one broker said.
The US soybean crop was set at 2,346 bln bushels from 2,270 bln last month and corn at 9,012 bln bushels versus 8,804 bln.
After around 90 minutes of trade Chicago soymeal futures were $6.9 to $7.8 lower.
